limits: Windows/.NET 10.0.13 x64, default tiered compilation, unencrypted loopback HTTP/1.1
Fresh process is not cold OS/filesystem cache
Readiness is stdout; no request or application handler warmup before first server request
First endpoint follows 20 control requests on another route
Every status/protocol/body and specialized header is validated; failures abort without retry
All measured samples retained; short warm windows do not establish tail latency
Benchmarks serialized while holding both heavy slots and the network lock
